criteria.R1: ROUTE-I CONSTRAINED_ROUTING with usable null ensemble
criteria.R2: real mean D_square significantly lower than N0, p_favorable < 0.05
criteria.R4: D_STITCH STRUC-PERC giant ratio >=0.95 with >=100 gap vertices
criteria.R5: usable N1 and real D_square < N1 with p_favorable <0.05
criteria.R6: usable N2 and real D_square < N2 with p_favorable <0.05
criteria.R7: high-D tail physical-intensity enrichment >1 with stratified p<0.05
criteria.R8: at least one preregistered restructuring class has higher D with p<0.05

interpretation.STRUCTURAL_PARTIAL_REPLICATION: R2 passes and at least one of R5/R6 passes, but one or more cross-chamber conditions fail
interpretation.ROUTE_ONLY_REPLICATION: R1 and R2 pass but both N1/N2 mechanism survival criteria fail or are underresolved
interpretation.NO_REPLICATION: R2 fails under a usable N0 ensemble

stopping_rule: One preregistered Pilot-B sample. Freeze outcome before defining Pilot C.
